info.name: Stripe Accounts Account Subscription Schedules API

params.name: canceled_at
params.description: Only return subscription schedules that were created canceled the given date interval.

params.name: completed_at
params.description: Only return subscription schedules that completed during the given date interval.

params.name: created
params.description: Only return subscription schedules that were created during the given date interval.

params.name: customer
params.description: Only return subscription schedules for the given customer.

params.name: ending_before
params.description: A cursor for use in pagination. `ending_before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with `obj_bar`, your subsequent call can include `ending_before=obj_bar` in order to fetch the previous page of the list.

params.name: expand
params.description: Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.

params.name: released_at
params.description: Only return subscription schedules that were released during the given date interval.

params.name: scheduled
params.description: Only return subscription schedules that have not started yet.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: A cursor for use in pagination. `starting_after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with `obj_foo`, your subsequent call can include `starting_after=obj_foo` in order to fetch the next page of the list.

items.docs: Retrieves the list of your subscription schedules.
Creates a new subscription schedule object. Each customer can have up to 500 active or scheduled subscriptions.

params.name: expand
params.description: Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.

items.docs: Retrieves the details of an existing subscription schedule. You only need to supply the unique subscription schedule identifier that was returned upon subscription schedule creation.

Cancels a subscription schedule and its associated subscription immediately (if the subscription schedule has an active subscription). A subscription schedule can only be canceled if its status is not_started or active.

Releases the subscription schedule immediately, which will stop scheduling of its phases, but leave any existing subscription in place. A schedule can only be released if its status is not_started or active. If the subscription schedule is currently associated with a subscription, releasing it will remove its subscription property and set the subscription’s ID to the released_subscription property.
